bounded_finding_titles.M2-B41: a nested acquisition counted a reference without revalidating the live kernel
bounded_finding_titles.M2-B42: a failed restoration left no debt, so the next acquisition adopted the residual value
bounded_finding_titles.M2-B43: helper ownership was released over an unreaped helper, and the cleanup could not be retried
bounded_finding_titles.M2-M44: the current validation artifacts asserted a physical qualification and its absence

historical_delegated_qualifications.disposition: The first delegated qualification of the previous closure.  Both failures were diagnosed and closed by that closure, and the failing transcript is preserved rather than discarded because a closure that hides its own failed qualification is the defect this milestone keeps closing.

The delegated run that qualified the previous closure after those two failures were closed.  It is the prior_physical_qualification of this pass and qualifies the code as it stood at the starting commit, not the code changed here.

known_limitations: The delegated physical qualification of this closure was performed by the operator against the modified worktree at the starting commit and passed: 399 tests, zero skips, zero failures, zero errors, under Delegate=yes, TasksMax=infinity and ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1.  It is a delegated-cgroup result on a development host: it is neither an installed-path qualification nor an independently accepted one, and neither is claimed.

The 309-test delegated transcript of the previous closure is historical here.  It qualified the code as it stood at the starting commit and does not qualify the code this closure changed; a prior physical transcript never qualifies modified code, so this closure was qualified by its own run above.

The restoration-debt latch is deliberately sticky and process-wide: once a restoration fails verification, every acquisition in that process refuses until settle_restoration_debt reads the owed baseline back.  On a host where PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER can fail, that turns one unobserved restoration into a refusal of every later effect in the same controller process.  This is the intended fail-closed behaviour and is disclosed rather than hidden.

A poisoned ownership stays poisoned after its outstanding references are released, even when the terminal release reads the baseline back, because release() may not clear a debt.  The settlement that clears it is one non-blocking pair of syscalls and is explicit.

PrivateMountHelper.close is retryable while its cleanup is incomplete, so a caller that supplies an exhausted deadline now returns with the helper unreaped and its ownership retained rather than releasing.  A caller that never retries leaves a live child and a set process-wide flag; that outcome is reported truthfully as cleanup_complete=false rather than concealed, and the retry is one call.

A failed start whose child could not be reaped inside the rollback's deadline leaves an entry in a process-local registry so its reap and its single release stay reachable.  Nothing sweeps that registry automatically; retry_unsettled_failed_starts is called by the caller that has time to spend.

The acquisition gate remains fail-closed: a kernel that does not implement PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, or a policy that refuses it, refuses the whole effect.  This is the accepted M2-B37 behaviour and is not changed here.

While a trusted helper is alive this controller is a child subreaper.  An orphaned descendant of this controller that no effect owns would reparent here and is not reaped, because reaping it would require waitpid(-1) and could consume an unrelated child.  The window is bounded by helper lifetime and is disclosed rather than closed.

A DeprecationWarning about fork() in a multi-threaded process is emitted when the trusted mount-namespace helper is forked.  It is pre-existing, non-failing, not introduced by this closure, and is NOT closed here.
EVID-08 remains IMPLEMENTED: the retry counter belongs to the Milestone 3 cumulative budgets.
Independent acceptance and installed-path qualification are not claimed.
Milestone 3 remains forbidden and was not started.

delegated_run.detail: The operator ran the five qualification modules inside a transient Delegate=yes systemd unit under ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1, against the worktree carrying the B41, B42, B43 and M44 changes at the starting commit.  Zero skips: under that variable a delegated test fails rather than skipping, so no result here can be a false green.

non_blocking_observations.disposition: Recorded truthfully as an existing non-blocking observation.  It appeared in the non-privileged regression as well, it is not introduced by this closure, it failed no test, and it is NOT claimed closed here.
non_blocking_observations.observation: DeprecationWarning: This process is multi-threaded, use of fork() may lead to deadlocks in the child.

m2_ownership_debt_reap_closure.operator_command:
cd /home/stris/work/agent-os-capsule-integration && \
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "paired-runner/m2-ownership-debt-reap-closure" && \
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2f7eaac796e6f4b3d93419ac3087183302b2a54e" && \
sudo systemd-run --quiet --wait --collect --pipe \
  --unit="admissible-m2-ownership-debt-reap-qualification-$$" \

  --property=Delegate=yes \

  --setenv=ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1 \
  /usr/bin/python3 -m unittest -v \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_b25_cgroup_topology \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_b25_final_failclosed \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_final_protocol_lifecycle \
  tests.test_admissible_paired_runner_m2_subreaper_deadline_closure \

Under that variable they fail instead of skipping, so the qualification run has zero skips or it is not green.

platform_contract.scope: This object describes the non-privileged development host on which the deterministic suite ran.  It is not the delegated qualification environment, whose properties are recorded under m2_ownership_debt_reap_closure.delegated_run.unit_properties.

prior_physical_qualification.scope: This transcript is historical evidence for the code as it stood at the starting commit, where it qualified the B37/B38/B39/B40 closure with zero skips.  It does not qualify the code changed by this repair; a prior physical transcript never qualifies modified code.

supersedes_prior_current_report.no_second_snapshot_file: The M2-M36 model keeps exactly one current validation report.  The fourth-repair snapshot exists as a file because its bytes were otherwise unreachable; these bytes are reachable from git and from the immutable closure report, so no third file is created.
supersedes_prior_current_report.preserved_in: the git object at the starting commit, and -- in full -- in the immutable implementation/M2_SUBREAPER_DEADLINE_CLOSURE_REPORT.json, which carries every claim the superseded report made about its own closure.
supersedes_prior_current_report.reason: The superseded report was the current artifact for the subreaper/deadline closure.  It carried a verified 309-test delegated transcript and, in the same current known_limitations, the statement that this closure's delegated qualification had not been performed -- one current artifact asserting a physical qualification and its absence, which is M2-M44.  This closure also changes the code that transcript qualified, so the transcript moves to prior_physical_qualification with qualifies_this_repair=false rather than staying beside unqualified modified code.

supersedes_validation_report.model: Option A -- versioned historical snapshot.  The superseded bytes are preserved under a clearly historical filename and the canonical filename carries the single current report, so a third party never has to decide which of two files is authoritative.
supersedes_validation_report.reason: M2-M36.  The superseded report carried the fourth-repair terminal refusal, a limitation declaring M2-B25 implemented but not physically qualified, cgroup delegation recorded as unavailable, and real delegated qualification recorded as false -- alongside two B25 closure objects recording a 125-test delegated run that had in fact succeeded.  One current artifact therefore asserted a physical qualification and its absence.  The bytes are preserved unchanged under the historical filename and this file is the sole current report.

test_counts.note: Counts are live discovery totals on the non-privileged development host.  The skipped count is exactly the delegated physical tests plus one legacy delegated test; under ADMISSIBLE_REQUIRE_DELEGATED_CGROUP=1 those tests fail rather than skip.
